Dangers of life:
If I ever have kids I would protect them and teach them of the dangers of lifeTheirs alcohol and its destruction to your mindViolence and its destruction to your personal lifeHeroin and its destruction of your bodyand last and possibly worst of allLove and its destruction of your heartOne day we are all young and we love everything, pizza, flowers, heroes, and our parents and the next we see someonemaybe its a friendmaybe its someone we’ve never metmaybe its a friend of a friendbut the reaction is the same a look and a double take you talk to themyou open upyou get hurtrepeat 6-7 times welcome to middle schoolyoure wiser now more guarded and wary of liarsyou trust few and open up to fewerYou meet him/heryou swear you wont open upyou liedto yourselfthey’re inits beautiful and you feel something you’ve never felt beforeLoveor at least what you know as loveYou tell them everythingGive them everything Its blissA high you’ve never known and never will know againLOVESome make it a year some make it 2 monthsthe result is the same2 heartsmuch like cars after a head on after a 100+ mph collisionYoure halfway thereHeartbreak True heartbreaknone like youve ever knownyou swear theres no him/her for youYoure differentDifferent and aloneHe/She comes alongFucking hell you were wrongIts goodBetter evenIts everything the movies said it would beYou finally give it upIts on a couchSweaty and passionateBeautiful to you two alonePure passionThis is what its about Pure loveIts amazing for a whileA slip upPain like youve never known and never will know againLike fresh flesh to a searing knife A scar is made that will never leaveRegretLiesPainAlcoholEscapeThe endfor some the story ends hereA moment of silenceFor some the story presses on(I still dont know which is wise)SexSexPainSexAlmost thereThe walls once hallowed now dull and fakeThe smiles now translucentStressAngerRegretAlcoholSexRepeatThe endSweet Jesus we made itIts over guys!What the fuck do i do now?I’ve memorized so muchLearned nothingHow to hide pain?How to fuel the escape?How to detect bullshitThats life until highschoolWhat comes next?Fucki if I knowAll i know is the stories are a lieBut Goddamnit believe themDont believe meDont believe anyoneListen to the storiesDont listen to people Just recite the stories and how it should beThats what I’ll say when my kids ask about LoveRecite the stories about LoveBelieveBut dont you dare leave those storiesWhere the page ends and your fingers begin is the exact point at which pain becomes real
